skills.name: Responses to German rule: resistance and protest

note.text: African responses included armed opposition, petitions, negotiation, evasion and defence of land or authority. Coastal conflict in {1884} must be distinguished from the later Duala land-expropriation protest associated with Rudolf Duala Manga Bell, executed in {1914}. Bakweri resistance is associated with Kuva Likenye and opposition to intrusion. Mamfe, Bangwa and Nso cases require attention to their own local sequence and sources, rather than being treated as one battle. Colonial accounts often frame resistance as disorder; historians must examine that standpoint.

sections.heading: Understand the ideas
sections.text: African responses included armed opposition, petitions, negotiation, evasion and defence of land or authority. Coastal conflict in {1884} must be distinguished from the later Duala land-expropriation protest associated with Rudolf Duala Manga Bell, executed in {1914}. Bakweri resistance is associated with Kuva Likenye and opposition to intrusion. Mamfe, Bangwa and Nso cases require attention to their own local sequence and sources, rather than being treated as one battle. Colonial accounts often frame resistance as disorder; historians must examine that standpoint.

sections.heading: Apply the ideas locally
sections.text: A petition against taking land is a form of resistance even when it is not a battlefield action. A regional comparison should ask what demand was opposed, which methods were used and what happened. The removal of Nso heritage during unequal colonial encounters also raises questions about coercion beyond an account of open warfare. No invented speech in this lesson is presented as an authentic quotation.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Use named local accounts and compare more than the colonial official's report. Keep early armed conflict separate from later legal and land protest. Teachers should supplement the detailed Mamfe, Bangwa and Nso campaign chronology from the approved course text; exact unsourced battle dates are not supplied here.
